probe: Whose timeline are we measuring against when we feel we are "falling behind"?
premise: Life has a shared schedule where people can be objectively ahead or behind.

pairs.reflection: idk uni people i guess. and my parents lol
pairs.reply: When you look at "uni people" and your parents, what is the standard they hold that tells you you are behind?

pairs.reflection: they have like proper careers. titles and stuff
pairs.reply: "Proper careers. Titles and stuff." What makes a career "proper"?

pairs.reflection: when people can say it in one sentence at parties
pairs.reply: When someone asks what you do at a party, what is being evaluated: what you do, or who you are?

pairs.reflection: both i guess. mostly who i am
pairs.reply: If your answer at a party evaluates who you are, what does that sentence say you are worth?

pairs.reflection: not much rn. like not enough
pairs.reply: "Not enough." Where does the standard come from that says a person has to earn their enoughness through a job title?

pairs.reflection: idk my parents probably. they're doctors
pairs.reply: "They're doctors." What did their being doctors teach you about what a life is supposed to look like?

pairs.reflection: that you pick one thing and stick to it. and get good at it
pairs.reply: If a life isn't picked once and stuck to, what does that make it in their eyes?
When you look at changing jobs four times, is it their eyes seeing "flaky", or yours?
When your own eyes call changing jobs "flaky", what is the rule they are using to measure you?

pairs.reflection: that if you leave you failed? idk
pairs.reply: Look at leaving a job that wasn't working. Is leaving failure, or is it learning what doesn't fit?

pairs.reflection: the bakery thing was kinda good tho. but thats not a real job
pairs.reply: "Not a real job." What makes baking not real compared to the one-sentence titles?

pairs.reflection: idk. no one at parties says wow a baker
pairs.reply: "No one at parties says wow a baker." When you imagine choosing between what feels "kinda good" to do and what makes people at parties say "wow", which one is living your life?
